Integration tutorial ↗ 
const garden = new Wayfinder({ width: 12, height: 10 });
garden.setCell({ x: 4, z: 3 }, { cost: 5 });
const route = garden.findPath(courier, destination);
world.setRoute(route.points); // Plain { x, y, z } coordinates.
Zero runtime dependenciesDeterministic A*Atomic grid edits

A map with clear boundaries

The route knows the tiles.

Planters block a cell. Lavender makes entering it cost five times more. Stairs, arches, and buildings decorate the garden’s edge; the navigator operates on one flat XZ grid.
